research_notes: The retry has generated enough substantive analytical work that another under-target classification would now more likely reflect timing/tool execution characteristics than a tiny backlog.
Nevertheless classification remains timestamp-based, not inferred from amount of work.
A durable close after target is the only clean-pass path.
If the run ends abruptly, surviving incremental evidence will permit the next invocation to estimate the last confirmed progress point.
That estimate must not be upgraded to an exact termination timestamp without evidence.
Conservative uncertainty handling is required near the eventual boundary.
